name: oarkflow-template-vscode
description: Language tooling and a formatter for Oarkflow SPL template files.

oarkflowTemplate.enableHtmlFiles.description: Enable SPL completion, hover, diagnostics, and definition support in HTML files.

oarkflowTemplate.maxDiagnostics.description: Maximum SPL diagnostics reported per document.

oarkflowTemplate.format.enable.description: Enable the SPL/HTML document and range formatter.

oarkflowTemplate.format.printWidth.description: Column the formatter wraps at. Lines that cannot be broken safely may still exceed it.

enumDescriptions: Respect the default CSS display of each element: whitespace around inline elements is preserved, whitespace around block elements may be reflowed.
Never add or remove whitespace anywhere. Safest, but produces less compact output.
Reflow whitespace freely. Most compact, but can change rendering of inline content.
oarkflowTemplate.format.whitespaceSensit.description: How carefully the formatter preserves whitespace between elements.

oarkflowTemplate.format.bracketSameLine.description: Put the closing `>` of a multi-line start tag on the last attribute line instead of on its own line.

oarkflowTemplate.format.indentEmbeddedCo.description: Re-indent the contents of <script>, <style>, and @handler blocks to match the surrounding markup. The code itself is never rewritten.

oarkflowTemplate.format.excludeFolders.description: Folder names skipped by SPL: Format Folder. Hidden folders (names starting with a dot) are always skipped.

oarkflowTemplate.format.maxFilesPerRun.description: Maximum number of files SPL: Format Folder will rewrite in a single run.

editor/context.when: (resourceExtname == .spl || resourceExtname == .tmpl || editorLangId == spl-template || editorLangId == html) && editorHasSelection

keybindings.when: editorTextFocus && !editorReadonly && (resourceExtname == .spl || resourceExtname == .tmpl || editorLangId == spl-template || editorLangId == html)

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/collect.js && node --check server/server.js
